description: Edge cases of the Brain API v1: keypad, consent declined, masked digits, silence, idempotency, auth failures, hold, Spanish on the phone, schema errors, web tokens, rate limit, turns after the end, health, brain-side redaction, explicit confirm, interruption, crisis. Replies are illustrative but follow the phone text rules and word budgets.

scenarios.title: Consent by keypad 1 (test call, GP_DEBUG_KEYS=1)

body.say: Hi, this is GatorPlate, a student-built AI assistant, not an official SF State service. An AI turns what you say into text to check CalFresh for you; the call audio isn't recorded.
body.ask: Okay to start? Say yes, or press one.

body.say: Great.
body.ask: Are you an SF State undergrad or grad student, and how many units are you taking this term?

exchanges.note: Keypad 1 = yes. The extra request field is ignored (tolerant reader).

scenarios.title: Consent declined by voice: coordinator number, then end

body.say: Hi, this is GatorPlate, a student-built AI assistant, not an official SF State service. An AI turns what you say into text to check CalFresh for you; the call audio isn't recorded.
body.ask: Okay to start? Say yes, or press one.

body.text: No, I don't want to do this.

body.say: No problem. If you want help from a person, the SF State CalFresh coordinator is at four one five, three three eight, one two zero three. Goodbye.

scenarios.title: Consent declined by keypad 2

body.say: No problem. If you want help from a person, the SF State CalFresh coordinator is at four one five, three three eight, one two zero three. Goodbye.

exchanges.note: Keypad 2 = no.

scenarios.title: Masked digits: SSN guidance, then the pending question again

body.text: Do you need my social? It's #########.

body.say: Please don't share your Social Security number. GatorPlate doesn't need it.
body.ask: What's your share of the rent?

exchanges.note: Nothing from this utterance is stored; the case records only a privacy event (ssn_blocked).

scenarios.title: Three silences in a row end the call with no_input

body.say: Are you there?
body.ask: Does anyone, like a parent, pay part of your rent straight to your landlord?

body.say: Still there?
body.ask: Does anyone pay part of your rent to your landlord for you? Press one for yes, two for no.

exchanges.note: Second silence: closed form with the keypad option.

body.say: I still can't hear you, so I'll end the call. The SF State CalFresh coordinator is at four one five, three three eight, one two zero three. Goodbye.

scenarios.title: Repeated start, repeated seq, gap, stale seq

body.say: Hi, this is GatorPlate, a student-built AI assistant, not an official SF State service. An AI turns what you say into text to check CalFresh for you; the call audio isn't recorded.
body.ask: Okay to start? Say yes, or press one.

body.say: Hi, this is GatorPlate, a student-built AI assistant, not an official SF State service. An AI turns what you say into text to check CalFresh for you; the call audio isn't recorded.
body.ask: Okay to start? Say yes, or press one.

exchanges.note: A repeated /start returns the stored first reply.

body.say: Great.
body.ask: Are you an SF State undergrad or grad student, and how many units are you taking this term?

body.say: Great.
body.ask: Are you an SF State undergrad or grad student, and how many units are you taking this term?

exchanges.note: Retry of seq 1: the stored reply comes back; the turn is not processed twice.

body.say: Thanks.
body.ask: How old are you, and who do you live with?

exchanges.note: seq 2 never arrived: a gap is accepted.

body.say: Thanks.
body.ask: How old are you, and who do you live with?

exchanges.note: Same seq with a different body: still the stored reply (bodies are not compared).

error.message: seq is older than the last accepted turn.

exchanges.note: seq 2 arrives late, after seq 3 was accepted.

scenarios.title: Turn and end for a call that was never started
Wrong signatures are rejected with 401 bad_signature

exchanges.note: The signature was made over a different body.
The signer included the query string in the signed path.

scenarios.title: Old timestamps are rejected; the 120 s edge is accepted

exchanges.note: Correct signature, but the timestamp is 300 s old (window is 120 s).
Exactly 120 s old: accepted.

scenarios.title: Student asks to wait: hold_s 30

body.text: Hold on, let me check my pay stub.

body.say: Sure, take your time.

exchanges.note: No silence event for 30 s; the student's next words arrive as a normal utterance.

body.text: Okay, it's about 900 a month, and nobody gives me cash.

body.say: Got it — about nine hundred dollars a month from work.
body.ask: How much is your share of the rent each month?

scenarios.title: Spanish requested on the phone: one Spanish notice, then English

body.text: Can we do this in Spanish? Español, por favor.

body.say: Esta línea es solo en inglés. Para hablar en español, usa GatorPlate en la web: gatorplate punto fly punto dev barra talk.

exchanges.note: One reply with lang es (Spanish voice for this reply only). Listening stays English.

body.say: Great.
body.ask: Are you an SF State undergrad or grad student, and how many units are you taking this term?

exchanges.note: Back to English.

scenarios.title: Web token bound to another call; web token starting a phone call

exchanges.note: The bearer token was issued for a different call_id.
A bearer token may only start a web call.

scenarios.title: Web session limit: 429 rate_limited

error.message: Too many sessions from this network. Try again later.

exchanges.note: More than 20 sessions in an hour from one IP address.

scenarios.title: Turns after the end

exchanges.note: The brain already sent end true: nothing more to say, hang up.
A second /end changes nothing.
Turn after /end.

scenarios.title: Health check (no auth, no data)
Web typed SSN digits are redacted by the brain

body.text: my social is one two three four five six seven eight nine, do you need it?

body.say: Please don't share your Social Security number. GatorPlate doesn't need it.
body.ask: What's your share of the rent?
body.display: Please don't share your Social Security number. GatorPlate doesn't need it. What's your share of the rent?

exchanges.note: The browser does not mask digits; the brain redacts spoken or written digit runs itself before anything else sees the text.

scenarios.title: Explicit confirm for a teen/ty amount

body.text: I make fifteen hundred a month, and nobody gives me cash.

body.ask: Just to check, did you say fifteen hundred dollars a month?

exchanges.note: fifteen/fifty can be misheard: one explicit confirm.

body.say: Thanks.
body.ask: How much is your share of the rent each month?

scenarios.title: Student spoke over the reply and did not answer

body.say: Sorry about that.
body.ask: How much is your share of the rent each month?

scenarios.title: Crisis words: 988 and 911 at once

body.text: Honestly, sometimes I think about hurting myself.

body.say: I'm really sorry you're going through this. You can call nine eight eight anytime, or call nine one one in an emergency.
body.ask: Do you want to keep going with the CalFresh check, or stop here?

exchanges.note: Crisis resources come first, in full (not interruptible).
